defect: RemoveColumn's STANDARD case lacks a break, so removing a standard column falls through into the default branch and throws NotImplementedException after the removal.
reason: The new switch added by this change is missing the break that the fix adds; the rest of the fix is formatting.

defect: The new LIMIT rewrite computes offset_val + limit_val in int64, which overflows (UB, negative bound, wrong result) when only OFFSET is given because limit_val then defaults to INT64_MAX.
reason: The overflowing upper-bound expression was added by this change (before it OFFSET threw), and the fix replaces it with a saturating TryAddOperator; seeing the overflow needs the INT64_MAX default from bound_result_modifier.hpp.

defect: D_ASSERT(value >= 0) after the wrapping unsigned subtraction of min_delta fails spuriously in debug builds when the deltas of a block span more than INT64_MAX, since the correct unsigned difference reads back as a negative int64.
reason: The wrong assertion was added by this change, and the fix replaces it with the always-valid signed check min_delta <= value before the subtraction.

defect: The new DUCKDB_NO_THREADS ConcurrentQueue uses std::queue without a template argument and calls nonexistent enqueue/dequeue members, so the no-threads build (e.g. WASM) does not compile.
reason: The whole #else branch was added by this change and the fix corrects exactly these lines to std::queue<unique_ptr<Task>> with push/front/pop.

defect: The fix resolves user types nested inside STRUCT/LIST/MAP (and changes the catalog lookup and alias handling) for the JSON custom type, extending the top-level-only resolution.
reason: This change only moved the existing top-level USER-type lookup from json_transform.cpp into a shared helper; the missing nested resolution already existed before it.

defect: GetJoinSide returns NONE for a column bound in neither child, so an expression mixing such an outer column with one side is classified as that side and the cross-product rewrite pushes the condition too deep.
reason: The NONE return replaced the former assert in this change, which also made the rewrite recurse into nested joins, and the fix changes exactly that return to BOTH; the consequence shows only in cross_product_rewrite.hpp.

defect: The new SchemaInSearchPath compares schema and catalog names case-sensitively, so SHOW TABLES misses entries when the search path or database name differs in case.
reason: The function was added by this change and the fix switches its three comparisons to CIEquals, as the neighbouring functions in the same file already did.

defect: The new WAL insert batching defers all appends to the end of Commit while QUERY entries are written immediately, so deletes/updates are replayed before the inserts they refer to, and insert-then-update/delete in one transaction hits assert(0) and is dropped.
reason: Both the deferred flush and the unhandled branch were added by this change, and the fix flushes appends before each query and handles the updated/deleted insertion.

defect: Including catalog, schema, table and column names in PreferCaseMatching penalises identifiers whose case differs from the prefix, so a mixed-case table such as "Funky Table With Spaces" is no longer the top suggestion for a lowercase prefix.
reason: The list of states was added by this change and the fix removes exactly those four entries to restore the shell autocomplete test's expected suggestion, which lives in another file.

defect: In the new ingest loop get_next is called on the ArrowArray holding the current batch before that batch is appended and released, overwriting an unreleased array (leaking it, and making any release at the end of the loop free the wrong batch).
reason: The loop and the misplaced get_next call were added by this change, and the fix moves get_next after the append, release and reallocation.

defect: String::operator< ignores the character comparison (the loop only breaks) and returns this_size < other_size, and it reads one byte past the shorter string when the sizes differ.
reason: The operator was added by this change and the fix rewrites the loop to a proper lexicographic comparison over the common length.

defect: MergeFunctionSet takes new_functions by value and pushes the existing overloads into that copy, so the merge is discarded, while it returns true and the caller then replaces the entry, losing existing overloads.
reason: In the old ClientContext code the existing functions were appended to the info that was then written; the move into FunctionSet by value broke that, and the fix appends the new functions to this->functions instead.

defect: RadixBitsOfPowerOfTwo returns RadixBits(n) = 64 - clz(n), which for n = 2^r is r + 1, an off-by-one against the old loop that returned r.
reason: The new implementation was introduced by this change, replacing a correct loop, and the fix subtracts the missing 1.
